subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve already-loaded plugins across scoped harness activation

question: Which lifecycle-safe seam should scoped harness activation use to add missing owners without rerunning, re-enabling, or replacing unrelated active plugin registrations?
rationale: The repository treats the mutable global registry as compatibility scaffolding, and choosing between an atomic registry merge, a request-scoped registry handle, or another owner-managed activation mechanism affects plugin lifecycle and compatibility beyond a mechanical patch.

options.title: Preserve registrations in place
options.body: Add a lifecycle-owned merge or missing-owner activation path that retains existing registrations, loads only missing owners, and applies the complete current activation policy.

options.title: Pause for registry redesign
options.body: Hold this PR and address scoped activation through the broader immutable or request-scoped registry direction before changing global replacement semantics.

recommendation.title: Preserve registrations in place
recommendation.body: Add a lifecycle-owned merge or missing-owner activation path that retains existing registrations, loads only missing owners, and applies the complete current activation policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available feature-history signal is their merged provider-owner activation work on the same function and tests.
